subtitle.title: Home Row — Left Hand Anchors
subtitle.subtitle: F (ថ), D (ដ), S (ស), A (ា)
subtitle.objective: Anchor left hand on home row keys A, S, D, F and practice basic finger movements.
subtitle.instructions: Place Left Pinky on A, Left Ring on S, Left Middle on D, and Left Index on F.

subtitle.title: Home Row — Right Hand Anchors
subtitle.subtitle: J (្), K (ក), L (ល), ; (ើ)
subtitle.objective: Anchor right hand on home row keys J, K, L, ; and practice right finger coordination.
subtitle.instructions: Place Right Index on J, Right Middle on K, Right Ring on L, and Right Pinky on Semicolon.

subtitle.title: Home Row — Center Index Reaches
subtitle.subtitle: G (ង) & H (ហ)
subtitle.objective: Reach inward from index fingers to type G (Left Index) and H (Right Index).
subtitle.instructions: Reach Left Index from F to G for ង. Reach Right Index from J to H for ហ. Always return to home.

subtitle.title: Home Row — Full Rhythm & Spacing
subtitle.subtitle: All Home Row Base Keys Combined
subtitle.objective: Consolidate all home row base keys with rhythmic keystrokes and proper thumb spacing.
subtitle.instructions: Keep wrists relaxed and fingers curved. Use thumbs for spacebar.

subtitle.title: First Syllables — Dependent Vowel ា (A)
subtitle.subtitle: Open Syllables with Vowel Sra Aa
subtitle.objective: Form open Khmer syllables by pairing consonants with dependent vowel ា on key A.
subtitle.instructions: Type the consonant key first, then press A with left pinky to attach vowel ា.

subtitle.title: First Syllables — Vowel ើ (;) & Sign ះ (Shift+H)
subtitle.subtitle: Vowel Sra Aee and Aspiration Sign Reahmuk
subtitle.objective: Learn vowel ើ on Semicolon and short aspiration sign ះ with Shift+H.
subtitle.instructions: Press Semicolon for ើ. Hold Shift and press H for sign ះ.

subtitle.title: Syllable Rhymes — Short Mark Bantoc ់ (')
subtitle.subtitle: Quote Key: Khmer Sign Bantoc
subtitle.objective: Shorten syllable vowel sounds using the Bantoc sign on the quote key.
subtitle.instructions: Reach Right Pinky to the quote key (') to place Bantoc ់ over the final consonant.

subtitle.title: Level 2 — Syllable Mastery Check
subtitle.subtitle: Home Row Words & Orthography Assessment
subtitle.objective: Verify typing precision on home row consonants, vowels, and diacritics.
subtitle.instructions: Focus on 100% accuracy before speed. Type each syllable deliberately.

subtitle.title: Top Row Base Consonants
subtitle.subtitle: T (ត), R (រ), Y (យ), Q (ឆ), P (ផ)
subtitle.objective: Reach upward from home row to type common top row base consonants.
subtitle.instructions: T = Left Index, R = Left Index, Y = Right Index, Q = Left Pinky, P = Right Pinky.

subtitle.title: Bottom Row Base Consonants
subtitle.subtitle: B (ប), C (ច), X (ខ), V (វ), N (ន), M (ម), Z (ឋ)
subtitle.objective: Reach downward from home row to type bottom row base consonants.
subtitle.instructions: B = Left Index, C = Left Middle, X = Left Ring, V = Left Index, N = Right Index, M = Right Index, Z = Left Pinky.

subtitle.title: Home Row Shift Consonant Pairs
subtitle.subtitle: Shift + K (គ), D (ឌ), F (ធ), G (អ), L (ឡ)
subtitle.objective: Master Second-Series voiced consonant pairs on the home row using Shift.
subtitle.instructions: Hold Shift with opposite hand: Shift+K = គ, Shift+D = ឌ, Shift+F = ធ, Shift+G = អ, Shift+L = ឡ.

subtitle.title: Upper & Lower Shift Consonants
subtitle.subtitle: Shift + Q (ឈ), T (ទ), P (ភ), X (ឃ), C (ជ), B (ព), N (ណ), Z (ឍ)
subtitle.objective: Master remaining upper and lower Shift consonants.
subtitle.instructions: Use opposite pinky for Shift while pressing the targeted upper/lower key.

subtitle.title: All 33 Consonants Fluency Drill
subtitle.subtitle: Complete Khmer Consonant Grid Assessment
subtitle.objective: Consolidate every Khmer consonant across all rows and both layers.
subtitle.instructions: Maintain consistent hand posture across all shifts and reaches.

subtitle.title: Upper Dependent Vowels — ិ, ី, ឹ, ឺ
subtitle.subtitle: Keys I, Shift+I, W, Shift+W
subtitle.objective: Master the four primary vowels situated on top of consonants.
subtitle.instructions: I = ិ, Shift+I = ី, W = ឹ, Shift+W = ឺ. Type consonant first, then vowel.

subtitle.title: Lower Dependent Vowels — ុ, ូ, ួ
subtitle.subtitle: Keys U, Shift+U, Shift+Y
subtitle.objective: Master vowels positioned below consonants and wrapping diphthongs.
subtitle.instructions: U = ុ, Shift+U = ូ, Shift+Y = ួ. Always type after base consonant.

subtitle.title: Front & Compound Vowels — េ, ែ, ៃ, ោ, ៅ
subtitle.subtitle: Keys E, Shift+E, Shift+S, O, Shift+O
subtitle.objective: Learn front and compound vowels without altering typing order.
subtitle.instructions: Always type Consonant first, then Vowel, even if the vowel renders to the left.

subtitle.title: Complex Vowels — ៀ, ឿ, េះ, ោះ, ាំ, ុំ, ុះ
subtitle.subtitle: BracketL, Shift+BracketL, Shift+V, Shift+;, Shift+A, Comma, Shift+Comma
subtitle.objective: Type diphthongs, nasal combinations, and compound vowel keys.
subtitle.instructions: [ = ៀ, Shift+[ = ឿ, Shift+V = េះ, Shift+; = ោះ, Shift+A = ាំ, Comma = ុំ, Shift+Comma = ុះ.

subtitle.title: Consonant + Vowel Synthesis
subtitle.subtitle: Integrated Khmer Syllables and Vocabulary
subtitle.objective: Attain fluid coordination across all dependent vowels.
subtitle.instructions: Type at a steady rhythm. Verify correct vowel key for each sound.

subtitle.title: The Subscript Engine — Coeng Key (J = ្)
subtitle.subtitle: Base Consonant + J (្) + Subscript Consonant
subtitle.objective: Learn how the Coeng key J triggers subscript generation under consonants.
subtitle.instructions: Press Base Consonant, press J (Right Index), then press Subscript Consonant.

subtitle.title: Common Subscript Words
subtitle.subtitle: Everyday Words with Single Subscripts
subtitle.objective: Type frequent Khmer words containing standard subscript consonants.
subtitle.instructions: Keep finger motion compact: Consonant -> J -> Subscript.

subtitle.title: Subscripts with Shift Consonants
subtitle.subtitle: J followed by Shift Consonants (្គ, ្ឃ, ្ជ, ្ទ, ្ធ, ្ភ, ្អ)
subtitle.objective: Combine Coeng key J with Shifted consonants.
subtitle.instructions: Type Consonant, press J, then hold Shift and press the subscript consonant.

subtitle.title: Subscripts with Surrounding Vowels
subtitle.subtitle: Sequential Typing: Consonant + Coeng + Vowel
subtitle.objective: Accurately type words with both subscript consonants and complex vowels.
subtitle.instructions: Strict Khmer order: Consonant -> J -> Subscript -> Vowel.

subtitle.title: Multi-Tier Subscript Clusters & Compounds
subtitle.subtitle: Advanced Cluster Mastery Assessment
subtitle.objective: Demonstrate mastery over complex multi-tier subscript clusters.
subtitle.instructions: Execute multi-step sequences with precision.

subtitle.title: Consonant Shifters — Muusikatoan & Triisap
subtitle.subtitle: Muusikatoan (Shift+') & Triisap (/)
subtitle.objective: Learn the consonant series shifters Muusikatoan (Shift+') and Triisap (/).
subtitle.instructions: Shift+' produces ៉ (Muusikatoan). Key / produces ៊ (Triisap). Type after the consonant.

subtitle.title: Tone & Sound Modifiers
subtitle.subtitle: Tandakhat (៍), Samiyok Sanna (័), Asda (៏), Robat (៌)
subtitle.objective: Learn diacritics modifying pronunciation and silencing letters.
subtitle.instructions: Shift+6 = ៍, Shift+7 = ័, Shift+8 = ៏, Shift+- = ៌.

subtitle.title: Repetition Sign (ៗ), Nikahit (ំ), Riel Currency (៛)
subtitle.subtitle: Keys Shift+2, Shift+M, Shift+4
subtitle.objective: Learn repetition sign Lek Tho (ៗ), nasal Nikahit (ំ), and Riel symbol (៛).
subtitle.instructions: Shift+2 = ៗ, Shift+M = ំ, Shift+4 = ៛.

subtitle.title: Diacritic & Sign Fluency Assessment
subtitle.subtitle: Comprehensive Vocabulary with Marks and Signs
subtitle.objective: Consolidate all signs, shifters, and diacritics in authentic vocabulary.
subtitle.instructions: Maintain typing pace across modifier combinations.
examples: ថ្ងៃអាទិត្យ
ព័ត៌មានវិទ្យា
ប្រយ័ត្នប្រយែង
ដើរលេងញឹកៗ

subtitle.title: Khmer Words — Family & People
subtitle.subtitle: Everyday Kinship & Relationship Terms
subtitle.objective: Type real-world family and kinship vocabulary with accurate spelling.
subtitle.instructions: Type whole words fluidly without stopping between individual characters.
examples: មិត្តភក្តិ

subtitle.title: Khmer Words — Nature & Environment
subtitle.subtitle: Landscape, Plants, Water & Places
subtitle.objective: Type vocabulary describing Cambodia's natural geography and environment.
subtitle.instructions: Focus on muscle memory for recurring syllable patterns.
examples: ទន្លេមេគង្គ
ផ្ទះសម្បែង

subtitle.title: Khmer Words — Food & Daily Living
subtitle.subtitle: Meals, Cuisine & Daily Routines
subtitle.objective: Type vocabulary related to culinary traditions and daily health.
subtitle.instructions: Maintain accurate subscript and vowel combinations.
examples: ម្ហូបឆ្ងាញ់

subtitle.title: Khmer Words — Education & Society
subtitle.subtitle: Schools, Work, Digital Tech & Community
subtitle.objective: Type modern vocabulary for education, society, and technology.
subtitle.instructions: Synthesize full keyboard knowledge across modern terms.
examples: កុំព្យូទ័រ
ទូរស័ព្ទដៃ
មន្ទីរពេទ្យ
ប្រទេសជាតិ

subtitle.title: Khmer Punctuation & Quotes
subtitle.subtitle: Khan (.), Bariyoosan (Shift+.), Quotes (« »), Colon (៖)
subtitle.objective: Learn Khmer punctuation marks and proper quotation conventions.
subtitle.instructions: Period = ។, Shift+Period = ៕, Grave = «, Shift+Grave = », AltGr+; = ៖.
examples: ភ្នំពេញ៖ រាជធានីនៃកម្ពុជា។
សួស្តី! តើសុខសប្បាយទេ?
ចប់បរិបូណ៌៕

subtitle.title: Simple Daily Sentences
subtitle.subtitle: Authentic Sentences with Zero-Width Word Spacing
subtitle.objective: Type full everyday sentences using proper word boundaries and punctuation.
subtitle.instructions: Use spacebar to separate words with zero-width spaces; conclude with Khan (។).
examples: ខ្ញុំស្រឡាញ់ក្រុមគ្រួសាររបស់ខ្ញុំ។
ថ្ងៃនេះអាកាសធាតុល្អណាស់។
ប្អូនស្រីរបស់ខ្ញុំចូលចិត្តអានសៀវភៅ។
យើងញ៉ាំបាយជុំគ្នាជាមួយឪពុកម្តាយ។

subtitle.title: Wisdom & Learning Sentences
subtitle.subtitle: Prose on Education, Diligence and Character
subtitle.objective: Type longer compound sentences with smooth transitions and consistent tempo.
subtitle.instructions: Keep hands centered on home row throughout full sentence typing.
examples: ចំណេះវិជ្ជាជាទ្រព្យសម្បត្តិដ៏មានតម្លៃ។
ការខិតខំរៀនសូត្រនាំមកនូវអនាគតភ្លឺស្វាង។
សាមគ្គីភាពជាកម្លាំងដ៏រឹងមាំនៃសង្គមជាតិ។
ចូរគោរពនិងដឹងគុណចំពោះលោកគ្រូអ្នកគ្រូ។

subtitle.title: Narrative Paragraph Assessment
subtitle.subtitle: Connected Multi-Sentence Typing Endurance
subtitle.objective: Demonstrate sustained typing accuracy on authentic Khmer narrative paragraphs.
subtitle.instructions: Read ahead slightly while typing to maintain uninterrupted flow.
examples: ប្រទេសកម្ពុជាជាទឹកដីសុវណ្ណភូមិដ៏ស្រស់បំព្រង។ ប្រជាជនខ្មែរមានភាពរួសរាយរាក់ទាក់ និងប្រកបដោយទឹកចិត្តសប្បុរសធម៌។ វប្បធម៌និងប្រពៃណីខ្មែរមានភាពសម្បូរបែបតាំងពីបុរាណកាលមក។

subtitle.title: Speed Sprint — Home Row Velocity
subtitle.subtitle: Rapid Keystrokes with 95% Accuracy Target
subtitle.objective: Build rapid finger speed and rhythm on familiar home row patterns.
subtitle.instructions: Push your typing speed while maintaining strict 95% accuracy.

subtitle.title: Speed Sprint — Rapid Subscript Clustering
subtitle.subtitle: Eliminate Hesitation on Coeng J Transitions
subtitle.objective: Achieve high-speed muscle memory on subscript cluster combinations.
subtitle.instructions: Transition through the Coeng key without dropping typing tempo.
examples: ផ្លូវស្ងួត
ម្ហូបឆ្ងាញ់
ក្មេងស្អាត

subtitle.title: Speed Sprint — Shift Layer Agility
subtitle.subtitle: Alternating Base and Shift Keystrokes
subtitle.objective: Seamlessly alternate between base and shift layers at pace.
subtitle.instructions: Coordinate pinky shift presses without disrupting hand positioning.

subtitle.title: Timed Speed & Accuracy Evaluation
subtitle.subtitle: Official 60-Second Timed Benchmark
subtitle.objective: Achieve your highest net WPM with at least 92% accuracy.
subtitle.instructions: Balance velocity with precision across mixed vocabulary.
examples: ការហ្វឹកហាត់វាយក្តារចុចនីដាជាប្រចាំជួយបង្កើនល្បឿននិងភាពជាក់លាក់។ យើងត្រូវរក្សាឥរិយាបថត្រង់ខ្លួន និងទុកម្រាមដៃលើជួរដេកដើមជានិច្ច។

subtitle.title: Independent Vowels (ស្រៈពេញតួ)
subtitle.subtitle: Keys Minus (ឥ), Equal (ឲ), BracketR (ឪ), Shift+BracketR (ឧ), Backslash (ឮ)
subtitle.objective: Master standalone independent vowels on the number row and AltGr layers.
subtitle.instructions: Minus = ឥ, Equal = ឲ, BracketR = ឪ, Shift+BracketR = ឧ, Backslash = ឮ, Shift+Backslash = ឭ, Shift+R = ឬ, AltGr+R = ឫ, AltGr+E = ឯ, AltGr+O = ឱ.

subtitle.title: Khmer Numerals, Dates & Statistics
subtitle.subtitle: Number Row Keys 1 to 0 (១, ២, ៣, ៤, ៥, ៦, ៧, ៨, ៩, ០)
subtitle.objective: Integrate Khmer digits on the number row into dates, prices, and statistics.
subtitle.instructions: Reach upward from home row fingers to the corresponding number keys.
examples: ម៉ោង០៨ និង៣០នាទីព្រឹក
សិស្សានុសិស្សចំនួន១២៥នាក់

subtitle.title: Classical Proverbs & Cultural Wisdom
subtitle.subtitle: Traditional Sayings with Quotes and Quotation Marks
subtitle.objective: Type classical Khmer proverbs and cultural literature with nuanced orthography.
subtitle.instructions: Observe correct quotation marks « » and traditional sentence termination.
examples: «ចេះដឹងនាំឱ្យមានប្រាជ្ញា»។
«ចំណេះវិជ្ជាជាទ្រព្យសម្បត្តិដ៏មានតម្លៃមិនចេះរីងស្ងួត»។
«ធ្វើគុណកុំទារគុណ ធ្វើទោសកុំលាក់បាំង»។
«ចេះមកពីរៀន មានមកពីរក»។

subtitle.title: NiDA Master Typist Capstone Examination
subtitle.subtitle: Full Keyboard Navigation, Orthography & High Speed
subtitle.objective: Demonstrate complete mastery over all facets of the Khmer NiDA keyboard system.
subtitle.instructions: Execute the comprehensive assessment with elite precision, fluid pacing, and zero errors.
examples: ព្រះរាជាណាចក្រកម្ពុជា ជាប្រទេសមួយដែលមានប្រវត្តិសាស្ត្រយូរអង្វែង និងមានសម្បត្តិវប្បធម៌ដ៏រុងរឿង។ ប្រាសាទអង្គរវត្តជាបេតិកភណ្ឌពិភពលោក និងជាមោទនភាពជាតិខ្មែរគ្រប់ជំនាន់។ យុវជនជំនាន់ក្រោយត្រូវខិតខំក្រេបជញ្ជក់ចំណេះវិជ្ជា និងបច្ចេកវិទ្យាដើម្បីអភិវឌ្ឍមាតុភូមិ។
